LESSON: SIGN READING 1.2.1 EXTENSIVE SIGN READING: INDEPENDENT SIGN READING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Sign Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Sign Reading: Independent Sign Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Sign Reading: Independent Sign Reading, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you select reading materials? 2. How can you ensure that you benefit from a sign reading session?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Sign Reading: Independent Sign Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Learner develops interpretation and inference skills as they search, collect, process, and use

information from selected texts.

● Self-efficacy: Learner develops self-awareness and planning skills as they keep a portfolio or a journal of their experiences during the

reading session.

Values:
● Respect: Learner displays positive regard for self and others while observing good reading habits.

● Responsibility: Learner displays accountability as they conduct peer review of the portfolios and journals kept.

Link to other Subjects:

Learner uses the concept of independent reading in many subjects such as Agriculture and Nutrition
